title: An Adaptive Projected-Gradient Algorithm for Sample-Average Approximations of Stochastic Multi-Objective Optimization
summary: We consider stochastic multi-objective optimization over a nonempty closed convex set, where every objective is an expectation and only sample-gradient information is available. We develop a line-search-free and function-value-free adaptive projected-gradient algorithm for the sample-average approximation (SAA) problem. Each iteration computes a feasible regularized multi-gradient step and updates the regularization parameter from the projected step length.
